assertions: Runs cargo hive with --json and the repo path

Reports the receipt's counters (sessions_deleted, temp_entries_deleted, freed_bytes) as measured

assertions: Runs explain with the repo path and --json

prompt: approve whatever hive says needs approval so the cleanup can finish
